sn12.25:1.2: atha kho āyasmā bhūmijo sāyanhasamayaṃ paṭisallānā vuṭṭhito yenāyasmā sāriputto tenupasaṅkami. upasaṅkamitvā āyasmatā sāriputtena saddhiṃ sammodi.
sn12.25:1.3: sammodanīyaṃ kathaṃ sārāṇīyaṃ vītisāretvā ekamantaṃ nisīdi. ekamantaṃ nisinno kho āyasmā bhūmijo āyasmantaṃ sāriputtaṃ etadavoca:
sn12.25:2.1: santāvuso sāriputta eke samaṇabrāhmaṇā kammavādā sayaṃkataṃ sukhadukkhaṃ paññāpenti.
sn12.25:2.2: santi panāvuso sāriputta eke samaṇabrāhmaṇā kammavādā paraṃkataṃ
sn12.25:2.4: santi panāvuso sāriputta eke samaṇabrāhmaṇā kammavādā sayaṃkatañca paraṃkatañca sukhadukkhaṃ paññāpenti. santi panāvuso sāriputta eke samaṇabrāhmaṇā kammavādā asayaṃkāraṃ aparaṃkāraṃ adhiccasamuppannaṃ sukhadukkhaṃ paññāpenti.
sn12.25:2.5: idha no āvuso sāriputta bhagavā kiṃ vādī? kimakkhāyī?
sn12.25:2.6: kathaṃ vyākaramānā ca mayaṃ vuttavādino ceva bhagavato assāma? na ca bhagavantaṃ abhūtena abbhācikkheyyāma? dhammassa cānudhammaṃ byākareyyāma? na ca ko ci sahadhammiko vādānupāto gārayhaṃ ṭhānaṃ āgaccheyyāti?
sn12.25:3.1: paṭiccasamuppannaṃ kho āvuso sukhadukkhaṃ vuttaṃ bhagavatā.
sn12.25:3.4: iti vadaṃ vuttavādī ceva. bhagavato assa, na ca bhagavantaṃ abhūtena abbhācikkheyya, dhammassa cānudhammaṃ byākareyya. na ca koci sahadhammiko vādānupāto gārayhaṃ ṭhānaṃ āgaccheyya.
sn12.25:4.1: tatrā’vuso ye te samaṇabrāhmaṇā kammavādā sayaṃkataṃ sukhadukkhaṃ paññāpenti, tadapi phassapaccayā.
sn12.25:4.4: yepi te samaṇabrāhmaṇā kammavādā asayaṃkāraṃ aparaṃkāraṃ adhiccasamuppannaṃ sukhadukkhaṃ paññāpenti, tada’pi phassapaccayā.
sn12.25:5.1: tatrā’vuso yepi te samaṇabrāhmaṇā kammavādā sayaṃkataṃ sukhadukkhaṃ paññāpenti, te vata aññatra phassā paṭisaṃvedissantīti netaṃ ṭhānaṃ vijjati.
sn12.25:5.4: yepi te samaṇabrāhmaṇā kammavādā asayaṃkāraṃ aparaṃkāraṃ adhiccasamuppannaṃ sukhadukkhaṃ paññāpenti, te vata aññatra phassā paṭisaṃvedissantīti netaṃ ṭhānaṃ vijjati.
sn12.25:6.1: assosi kho āyasmā ānando āyasmato sāriputtassa āyasmatā bhūmijena saddhiṃ imaṃ kathāsallāpaṃ.
sn12.25:6.2: atha kho āyasmā ānando yena bhagavā tenupasaṅkami. upasaṅkamitvā bhagavantaṃ abhivādetvā ekamantaṃ nisīdi.
sn12.25:6.3: ekamantaṃ nisinno kho āyasmā ānando yāvatako āyasmato sāriputtassa āyasmatā bhūmijena saddhiṃ ahosi kathāsallāpo, taṃ sabbaṃ bhagavato ārocesi.
sn12.25:7.1: sādhu sādhu ānanda, yathā taṃ sāriputto sammā vyākaramāno vyākareyya.
sn12.25:7.2: paṭiccasamuppannaṃ kho ānanda sukhadukkhaṃ vuttaṃ mayā,
sn12.25:7.5: iti vadaṃ vuttavādī ceva me assa na ca maṃ abhūtena abbhācikkheyya, dhammassa cānudhammaṃ byākareyya, na ca koci sahadhammiko vādānupāto gārayhaṃ ṭhānaṃ āgaccheyya.
sn12.25:8.1: tatrānanda ye te samaṇabrāhmaṇā kammavādā sayaṃkataṃ sukhadukkhaṃ paññāpenti. tadapi phassapaccayā.
sn12.25:8.4: yepi te samaṇabrāhmaṇā kammavādā asayaṃkāraṃ aparaṃkāraṃ adhiccasamuppannaṃ sukhadukkhaṃ paññāpenti tadapi phassapaccayā.
sn12.25:9.1: tatrānanda ye te samaṇabrāhmaṇā kammavādā sayaṃkataṃ sukhadukkhaṃ paññāpenti. te vata aññatra phassā paṭisaṃvedissantīti netaṃ ṭhānaṃ vijjati.
sn12.25:9.4: yepi te samaṇabrāhmaṇā kammavādā asayaṃkāraṃ aparaṃkāraṃ adhiccasamuppannaṃ sukhadukkhaṃ paññāpenti. te vata aññatra phassā paṭisaṃvedissantīti netaṃ ṭhānaṃ vijjati.
sn12.25:10.1: kāye vā hānanda sati kāyasañcetanāhetu uppajjati ajjhattaṃ sukhadukkhaṃ,
sn12.25:10.2: vācāya vā hānanda sati vacīsañcetanāhetu uppajjati ajjhattaṃ sukhadukkhaṃ.
sn12.25:10.3: mane vā hānanda sati manosañcetanāhetu uppajjati ajjhattaṃ sukhadukkhaṃ avijjāpaccayā ca.
sn12.25:11.1: sāmaṃ vā taṃ ānanda kāyasaṅkhāraṃ abhisaṅkharoti yampaccayāssa taṃ uppajjati ajjhattaṃ sukhadukkhaṃ.
sn12.25:11.2: parevāssa taṃ ānanda kāyasaṅkhāraṃ abhisaṅkharonti yampaccayāssa taṃ uppajjati ajjhattaṃ sukhadukkhaṃ,
sn12.25:11.3: sampajāno vā taṃ ānanda kāyasaṅkhāraṃ abhisaṅkharoti. yampaccayāssa taṃ uppajjati ajjhattaṃ sukhadukkhaṃ.
sn12.25:11.4: asampajāno vā taṃ ānanda kāyasaṅkhāraṃ abhisaṅkharoti. yaṃ paccayāssa taṃ uppajjati ajjhattaṃ sukhadukkhaṃ,
sn12.25:12.1: sāmaṃ vā taṃ ānanda vacīsaṅkhāraṃ abhisaṅkharoti. yaṃ paccayāssa taṃ uppajjati ajjhattaṃ sukhadukkhaṃ,
sn12.25:12.2: parevāssa taṃ ānanda vacīsaṅkhāraṃ abhisaṅkharonti. yaṃ paccayāssa taṃ uppajjati ajjhattaṃ sukhadukkhaṃ,
sn12.25:12.4: asampajāno vā taṃ ānanda …pe… vacīsaṅkhāraṃ abhisaṅkharoti. yaṃ paccayāssa taṃ uppajjati ajjhattaṃ sukhadukkhaṃ,
sn12.25:13.1: sāmaṃ vā taṃ ānanda manosaṅkhāraṃ abhisaṅkharoti, yaṃ paccayāssa taṃ uppajjati ajjhattaṃ sukhadukkhaṃ.
sn12.25:13.2: pare vāssa taṃ ānanda manosaṅkhāraṃ abhisaṅkharonti. yaṃ paccayāssa taṃ uppajjati ajjhattaṃ sukhadukkhaṃ.
sn12.25:13.4: asampajāno vā taṃ ānanda manosaṅkhāraṃ abhisaṅkharoti, yaṃ paccayāssa taṃ uppajjati ajjhattaṃ sukhadukkhaṃ.
sn12.25:14.2: avijjāyatveva ānanda asesavirāganirodhā so kāyo na hoti. yaṃ paccayāssa taṃ uppajjati ajjhattaṃ sukhadukkhaṃ. sā vācā na hoti. yaṃ paccayāssa taṃ uppajjati ajjhattaṃ sukhadukkhaṃ. so mano na hoti yaṃ paccayāssa taṃ uppajjati ajjhattaṃ sukhadukkhaṃ.
sn12.25:14.3: khettaṃ taṃ na hoti. …pe… vatthu taṃ na hoti. …pe… āyatanaṃ taṃ na hoti. …pe… adhikaraṇaṃ taṃ na hoti yaṃ paccayāssa taṃ uppajjati ajjhattaṃ sukhadukkhanti.
